original_question:
Write a Verilog module named `karnaugh_map`.
The module should have four single-bit inputs named `A`, `B`, `C`, and `D`.
The module should have one single-bit output named `F`.
Implement the combinational logic behaviorally such that the output `F` is the result of the logical XOR operation between inputs `B`, `C`, and `D`. The input `A` should not affect the output `F`.
